description: cluster 级写作流水线 7 步 · v2 cluster 化方案（2026-05-28）：cluster 单层 + scanner 全员升维 + 切章是纯格式输出 0 质检
_v2_principle: 整个系统为故事块服务 · 章节是输出格式 · scanner 全部 cluster 视野 · 切章后不再有任何质检
_doc_v24: 流水线倒置：cluster_draft → cluster 级所有改进 → 全 clean 后才 splitter → gen_chapter_titles → per-chapter changes 拆分。审查 agent 全 cluster mode。1 个 cluster = 1 次 cluster-write plan

steps.name: build-manifest+style-directive
steps.description: build_manifest.py 生成 cluster 起首章 manifest（注入 cluster brief + 全 25+ 子系统状态）+ style_injector 注入风格指令

steps.name: novel-writer-ecas-only
steps.description: spawn novel-writer MODE=ecas · writer 只产 cluster_draft.txt + cluster_changes.json · **禁止调 splitter**（splitter 推迟到 step 6）

steps.name: cluster-quality-full-stack
steps.description: v2 cluster 全面质检（2026-05-28）· 13 个 cluster 视野 scanner 并行跑：9 个升维 scanner（validate_chapter/validate_style/narrative/plot_structure/hook_strength_拟切点节奏/golden_three_仅cluster_001/semantic_slop/short_sentence/repeat_noun_density）+ 4 个新 cluster-only scanner（cross_scene_voice_drift/foreshadowing_handoff/locked_fact_cross_scene/pov_consistency）· 机械轨：audit_hub.py --mode cluster --cluster-id {key} · 阅读轨：spawn novel-reading-reflector MODE=ecas ROUND=1 → fix → ROUND=2 → ... 连续 3 轮 0 issue 才放行

steps.name: cluster-voice-keeper
steps.description: spawn novel-voice-checker MODE=cluster · 整 cluster 对话声纹审查（所有角色 voice_pack 校验 + 跨场景 voice 漂移检测）

steps.name: cluster-foreshadower+reflector+summarizer
steps.description: cluster 级三 agent 串行：foreshadower（整 cluster 伏笔评估）+ reflector（整 cluster 经验提取）+ summarizer（cluster 级摘要）

steps.name: splitter+chapter-titles+per-chapter-changes-zero-audit
steps.description: v2 cluster 化方案 · 纯格式输出步骤 · 0 质检（章节是输出格式，不是检测单位）· v27 freestyle 默认：调度器先检测上 cluster 的 章节/cluster_<prev>_draft/cluster_<prev>_pending_tail.txt 是否存在，存在则透传 PREVIOUS_PENDING_TAIL_PATH（splitter prepend 到本 cluster 草稿头联合切）· spawn novel-chapter-splitter MODE=ecas_freestyle（按字数硬范围 3000-4500/章自动算 N · 末章<3000 退回 cluster_<key>_pending_tail.txt 不强切）或 ecas_multi_chapter（_writer_mode=locked 兼容 · cluster_001 默认带倒叙 narrative_mode=in_medias_res）→ gen_chapter_titles.py --chapters <range>（normal/mid/high 三档）→ split_cluster_changes.py 把 cluster_changes.json 平铺到 N 个 第NNN章_changes.json · ★ 切章后 0 audit/0 scanner/0 质检 · 直接进 step 7 plan-end
scripts: # 0) v27 跨 cluster 补料检测: 上 cluster pending_tail 存在则透传 PREVIOUS_PENDING_TAIL_PATH
# 1) spawn novel-chapter-splitter MODE=ecas_freestyle CLUSTER_ID={key} CLUSTER_START_CH=<start> [PREVIOUS_PENDING_TAIL_PATH=$PREV_PENDING_TAIL] (locked 走 ecas_multi_chapter)

# freestyle 内部入口: python core/scripts/chapter_splitter.py {project_root} --mode ecas_freestyle --cluster-id cluster_{key} --cluster-start-ch <start> --draft {project_root}/章节/cluster_{key}_draft/cluster_{key}_draft.txt [--previous-pending-tail $PREV_PENDING_TAIL]

steps.name: plan-end
steps.description: 报告 cluster_write 完成 + plan 最终校验 + 准备进入 cluster-save-state
